protocol.same_stopping_rule: Audit.decision exact set, with method-specific legal action ordering
protocol.budget_definition: sum of all legal post-edit relay row and conditional-cell prices per unit
protocol.full_ctdr_mask_source: graph_manifest.edge_to_relay_descendants, never sealed labels or row-level metadata
protocol.oracle_definition: restricted row-refresh optimum over changed relay rows
protocol.oracle_lower_bound_definition: zero if exact warm cache is exact, otherwise cheapest changed-row query
protocol.oracle_selection: hindsight target labels select the offline plan only
protocol.oracle_prediction: plan actions are independently replayed before scoring
protocol.oracle_scope: restricted changed-row actions, not a global action-space optimum

privacy: question keys, sealed labels, predictions, targets and action traces omitted
